modes.cue_notes: From a forward fold, inhale to lift the torso to a flat back, spine parallel to the floor. Hands may land on shins, thighs, or blocks. Draw the shoulder blades toward each other and gaze slightly forward to lengthen the neck.

breathing_cues.entering: Inhale as you lift the chest and lengthen the spine to a flat back.
breathing_cues.holding: Hold the breath briefly or breathe evenly while reaching the crown forward and tailbone back.
breathing_cues.exiting: Exhale to fold forward again, or inhale to rise into a standing position.

notes: Common vinyasa transition point linking forward fold and upward stances; reinforces spinal lengthening before folding or rising.
